title: CyberSoft RAG Tutor Knowledge Base & Evaluation Benchmark
description: Educational knowledge base corpus and gold-standard QA evaluation dataset for training and benchmarking CyberSoft RAG Tutor. Contains curriculum textbook markdown documents, semantic chunking metadata with 1536-dim vector embeddings, and expert ground-truth question-answer-citation triplets.

pii.handling_instructions: Internal curriculum knowledge base. Content is proprietary to CyberSoft Academy; authorized for student model training and evaluation harnesses only.

upstream_sources: CyberSoft Data Analyst Syllabus Markdown Docs
CyberSoft AI Engineer Lecture Slides & Tutorials
transformation_pipeline: Extract structured markdown sections from official curriculum repositories
Chunk text with chunk_size=500 tokens, overlap=50 tokens
Senior instructors author 200 gold-standard ground-truth QA evaluation triplets with exact citations

core_competencies: Dense Vector Embeddings & Similarity Search (Cosine, Inner Product)
RAG Triad Evaluation: Context Precision, Faithfulness, Answer Relevance
sample_business_questions: How does hybrid retrieval (BM25 keyword + dense embeddings) improve retrieval recall on technical terminology?
What is the system faithfulness score when answering questions regarding Python decorators?
Does the RAG system correctly refuse to answer questions outside the CyberSoft syllabus?
recommended_exercises: Lab 07: Implement chunking and populate a local Qdrant vector database.
Lab 08: Implement custom prompt templates with citation constraints.
Capstone: Build automated regression evaluation harness using Ragas framework.
